instruction: A candid documentary medium shot shows a playful outdoor game. On the left, the man in the patterned shirt (R3) is blindfolded, smiling as he swings a yellow bat upward at a red piñata. On the right, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) laughs joyfully while watching him. The background consists of lush green trees and bushes. Soft, natural daylight fills the scene, casting gentle shadows and highlighting their happy expressions as they play together.
